messages:
sam-support: FYI customer 'NorthPoint Logistics' reported a USD wire returned this morning with reason 'Account type mismatch'. Need quick triage — funds are in our settlement account.
maria-payments: Copy — can you paste the wire details (masked) and the MT103/proprietary message from the receiving bank?
kai-banking: Got the bank message from the correspondent: 'RETURNED: ACCT_TYPE_MISMATCH - Beneficiary acct type does not match provided legal entity details.' Attached note: beneficiary flagged as 'savings' but institution expects 'checking' and business vs individual mismatch.
sam-support: Here are the details (masked):
```
amount: USD 42,500.00
date: 2026-03-16 09:12 UTC
beneficiary_name: NorthPoint Logistics Inc
acct: ****6789
routing/ABA: 071000013
beneficiary_bank_swift: WELLSUS3XXX
our_xref: INV-5543
correspondent_note: ACCT_TYPE_MISMATCH
```
anne-support: Did customer provide a PO or company registration (EIN) on the invoice? Sometimes correspondent banks require legal entity docs for corporate accounts.
maria-payments: Checking invoice — it has 'NorthPoint Logistics' but the company type field in our billing form was left blank (they used a personal email). No PO number either. That could have triggered additional manual checks by the beneficiary bank.
bank-ops-bot: Auto-check: beneficiary name vs company registry: match found for "NorthPoint Logistics, Inc." but account type in beneficiary bank records is 'Commercial - Checking'. Payment metadata indicates 'BeneficiaryAcctType: SAVINGS' -> raises ACCT_TYPE_MISMATCH.
kai-banking: Looks like our SWIFT payload included an extra subfield that set acct type to SAV. Could be from our legacy ACH mapping when the payer marked 'business' incorrectly. Repro steps:
1) Use payments service to create wire with payload field "beneficiary_account_type: SAV"
2) Send through staging correspondent (swift-sim)
3) Observe returned MT199 with ACCT_TYPE_MISMATCH.
sam-support: Is there a quick fix to reissue? Customer wants funds to reach vendor today.
maria-payments: We can re-issue same-day if we cancel and re-send. But we need confirmation from customer of correct account type and ideally a bank-confirmed proof (bank statement or vendor confirmation). I can RFC to the customer now.
anne-support: Customer reply: "We have a corporate checking account — attached bank letter." They uploaded a PDF.
kai-banking: Good. Action plan: (1) Flag original trace and mark as returned; (2) request customer to confirm 'beneficiary_account_type: CHECKING' in the payment form; (3) create new wire with corrected acct type and include MT103 narrative line referencing original trace. I'll also set the routing normalization to strip legacy SAV tag to avoid mapping it next time.
maria-payments: I initiated a resend request. Note for records: this counts as a failed outbound; advise Finance to expect a reversal and a resend charge. I'll add a billing incident.
payments-bot: Payment INV-5543: original txn 0x8f3a returned at 2026-03-16T09:44Z reason=ACCT_TYPE_MISMATCH. New txn queued 0x8f3b pending customer confirmation.
bank-ops-bot: Opened escalation ticket with correspondent bank ID CB-20260316-07 to request waive of return fees due to mapping error on our side.
sam-support: Thanks all. Maria — keep me posted when new wire clears. Kai — please add a short postmortem item to prevent wrong acct-type tags in mappings.
maria-payments: Will do, pinging customer now. :phone:
kai-banking: Adding postmortem note and a quick unit test against beneficiary_account_type field. ETA: today EOD.
anne-support: Closing loop once bank confirms funds delivered. :thumbsup:
